question: If (sin x + sin y) = a and (cos x + cos y) = b, then find the value of (sin x sin y + cos x cos y).
solution:
**Given:**

sin x + sin y = a

cos x + cos y = b

**Formula Used:**

sin x sin y + cos x cos y = cos(x - y)

**Calculation:**

sin x + sin y = a

squaring on both side we get,

⇒ (sin x + sin y)² = a²

⇒ sin²x + sin²y + 2sinxsiny = a²...................(1)

cos x + cos y = b

squaring on both side we get,

⇒ (cos x + cos y)² = b²

⇒ cos²x + cos²y + 2cosxcosy = b2</s
